resources.title: Prospero Explorer
resources.description: Browse console files, manage archives and packages, and use the project’s network tools.
resources.compatibility: PS5 native folder module, PPSA99109. Publisher installation uses dump_installer and a home-screen launch; its pinned README/release does not supply a firmware test matrix.
resources.preparation: This ZIP has eboot.bin, sce_module and sce_sys at its root. Extract all four files into a folder such as PPSA99109, place that folder under /homebrew on the selected USB drive or /data/homebrew on the console, install with dump_installer, then launch its home-screen tile.
requirements: An active PS5 homebrew environment compatible with the publisher's native module
dump_installer for registration, as specified in the v1.0 release
Keep sce_module/libc.prx and sce_sys beside eboot.bin
installationSteps: Extract the ZIP into a new PPSA99109 folder; it does not already contain that outer folder.
Copy the complete folder to USB /homebrew/PPSA99109 or internal /data/homebrew/PPSA99109, then use dump_installer.
Launch from the home screen. Use its archive, file and network pages deliberately; settings/logs are under /data/prospero-explorer.

firmwareSupport.notes: No app-specific firmware matrix was found in the pinned v1.0 README/release; do not infer support from param.json's SDK/system-version fields.

resources.networkIntegration: The Network page exposes the app's file service with its own login, read-only and root settings. Use the address displayed by that service; no ezRemote endpoint compatibility is claimed.

resources.title: Prospero Multi Tools
resources.description: Manage supported homebrew and backup layouts. The project requires its unjail payload.
resources.compatibility: PS5 native module PPSA99110; requires SvenGDK's unjail daemon on a firmware it supports. The daemon must be running before the app starts and must be sent again after a reboot. PS1/PS2/PSP launch functions additionally require the separate emulator resources.
resources.preparation: Extract the included PPSA99110 folder and copy it intact to USB /homebrew/PPSA99110 or internal /data/homebrew/PPSA99110. Register with dump_installer, send the author's unjail payload before opening, and use Diagnostics to check actual reachable storage. EmulatorPack.zip is a separate dependency for emulator launch features.
requirements: Firmware covered by the author's unjail-ps5app-payload support table
unjail daemon active whenever the module needs storage or install access outside its sandbox
dump_installer
Separate emulator folders and emulator-resources for PS1/PS2/PSP launch features
installationSteps: Keep the whole PPSA99110 folder, including sce_module and sce_sys, at /data/homebrew/PPSA99110 or the selected USB drive's /homebrew/PPSA99110.
Install with dump_installer; send unjail before opening and again after reboot.

Use Diagnostics and Refresh storage to inspect reachable roots. The app documents that its file/folder picker does not yet offer /data and /user even though its broker-backed install/launch operations can reach them.
Only for emulator launching: obtain the author's emulator resources and follow the separate /data/homebrew/emulators and emulator-resources layout.

firmwareSupport.notes: The app defers firmware support to its unjail dependency. The daemon separately reports one hardware-tested firmware and an offset-coverage table; that is not an app-wide hardware test matrix.

primaryDocumentation.label: Required unjail daemon and firmware support

resources.networkIntegration: Diagnostics checks the escalation daemon, file broker and actual reachable roots; PS5 Tools also offers its documented payload sender and service-port probes. Backup inspection for other consoles is not a claim that those console games run natively on PS5.

resources.title: DriftCheck
resources.description: Inspect DualSense sticks, drift, buttons, triggers, touchpad and motion input.
resources.compatibility: PS5 native title PPSA98766. Publisher requires a jailbroken PS5, kstuff, ShadowMountPlus and an ELF loader on port 9021. No firmware number is specified in the pinned README.
resources.preparation: Extract and copy the complete PPSA98766 folder to /data/homebrew/PPSA98766; preserve 0777 permissions on its files. Keep sce_module/libc.prx and sce_sys. The author's separate DriftCheck.elf installer is an alternative upstream download, rather than this ZIP being a payload.
requirements: kstuff
ShadowMountPlus
ELF loader listening on port 9021
DualSense belonging to the user who launched the app
installationSteps: For this selected ZIP, extract PPSA98766 and upload the whole folder under /data/homebrew/.
Check 0777 permissions if FTP changed them; the publisher identifies CE-107750-0 as the failure symptom.
Wait for ShadowMountPlus registration, launch its tile, then use Options for the rest/circularity tests.

firmwareSupport.notes: Pinned README names the required homebrew components without an app-specific firmware matrix.

resources.title: ScreenTester5
resources.description: Display test patterns to inspect screen geometry, colour uniformity and pixels.
resources.compatibility: PS5 native title PPSA69420; the author requires a jailbroken PS5 with ShadowMountPlus. This release is a native app-folder build, rather than the removed websrv/elfldr payload build. The pinned README gives no firmware matrix.
resources.preparation: Extract the PPSA69420 folder intact to /data/homebrew/PPSA69420. ShadowMountPlus adds its home-screen tile. Keep eboot.bin, sce_module/libc.prx and sce_sys; close the app using the PS button.
requirements: Jailbroken PS5 with ShadowMountPlus
installationSteps: Extract PPSA69420.zip and copy its PPSA69420 folder under /data/homebrew/.
Wait for the ShadowMountPlus scan, then launch from the home screen.
Follow the app's own confirmation before flashing test patterns; close it with the PS button.

firmwareSupport.notes: No app-specific firmware test matrix in the pinned README/release.

resources.title: Chiral-FTP
resources.description: Manage console files and connect through the project’s FTP, SFTP and web tools.
resources.compatibility: PS5 native title PPSA96024. Requires ShadowMountPlus and elfldr listening on port 9021 at app startup for full storage access. The author reports testing on firmware 13.60; other firmware is untested in the pinned README.
resources.preparation: Copy the complete PPSA96024 folder to /data/homebrew/PPSA96024 and preserve 0777 on the folder and every file. Launch from the dashboard with elfldr active. Its start screen reports whether full storage access succeeded; closing the app stops its servers.
requirements: ShadowMountPlus
ELF loader on port 9021 when the app starts
0777 app-folder/file permissions, as documented by the author
installationSteps: Extract chiral-ftp-ps5-1.1.zip and copy the complete PPSA96024 folder to /data/homebrew/PPSA96024.
Check 0777 permissions if your FTP client changed them. Keep lapy.elf, libc.prx and all other shipped dependencies.
Start the app and confirm its full-storage-access message.

Choose FTP server or Web app and use the address/login shown on screen. Its browser interface supports browsing, download/upload and file operations; Quick connect requires its on-screen approval code.

firmwareSupport.notes: Publisher hardware test, not testing performed by this site. Other versions are untested in the pinned README.

primaryDocumentation.label: Pinned PS5 requirements and file-manager setup

resources.networkIntegration: Open the running app's Web app or FTP server screen and use its displayed endpoint and login. These are Chiral's services; the site's ezRemote JSON commands must not be sent to them. Quick connect uses a code shown on both devices and explicit Allow.

resources.title: ProsperoRadio
resources.description: Browse internet radio stations, save favourites and control playback with DualSense.
resources.compatibility: PS5 native media app PPSA99001, content version 01.000.010. Publisher says it is tested on PS5 but supplies no firmware-specific matrix for this release. Internet access is required to browse and stream stations.
resources.preparation: Extract and copy the entire PPSA99001 folder to /data/homebrew/PPSA99001 using your compatible PS5 homebrew app loader. Keep its runtime libraries, assets and helpers. The setup guide says not to leave a same-title FFPFSC image from an earlier release beside this folder; automatic updater compatibility is unverified.
requirements: Compatible PS5 native homebrew app installation/launch environment
Internet access for station discovery and streams
installationSteps: Extract PPSA99001.zip and copy the complete PPSA99001 folder under /data/homebrew/.
Avoid a second registration of the same title from an older FFPFSC image beside the folder; preserve your old archive separately.
Launch the native media app. Use publisher Releases for updates; the README does not verify the replacement automatic-update service.

firmwareSupport.notes: Release says tested and working on PS5; no firmware number is given.

primaryDocumentation.label: Pinned folder deployment and version rules

resources.title: CD Player
resources.description: Play audio discs using supported USB CD hardware and the project’s music interface.
resources.compatibility: PS5 native media app PPSA98427. Requires a compatible active homebrew environment and an external USB optical drive that reads audio CDs; it does not use the PS5's internal drive. The author tested Apple USB SuperDrive on firmware 13.60. A local ELF loader on port 9021 may be needed for its access helper.
resources.preparation: Copy the full PPSA98427 folder under /data/homebrew so eboot.bin is directly at /data/homebrew/PPSA98427/eboot.bin, then launch CD Player from Media. Preserve 0777 permissions and its title-specific lapy.elf helper. Boot with the external drive empty, then insert the audio CD after boot.
requirements: Compatible active PS5 homebrew app environment
Supported external USB audio-CD drive; internal console drive is not used
Local ELF loader on port 9021 may be required for the bundled title-specific helper
installationSteps: Extract PPSA98427.zip and copy the complete PPSA98427 folder under /data/homebrew/ without adding another nested folder.
Keep every shipped asset/helper and preserve 0777 permissions if copying by FTP.
Start the console with the USB optical drive empty; launch CD Player from Media and insert your audio CD after boot.
For an older installation reserving about 18 GB, follow the author's 1.1.2 reinstall instructions; replacing loose files alone does not shrink that reservation.

firmwareSupport.notes: Publisher tested an Apple USB SuperDrive on this firmware. Other drive/firmware/output combinations need their own verification.

primaryDocumentation.label: Pinned USB hardware, installation and update notes

resources.title: Surround Sound Studio
resources.description: Test HDMI audio formats and speaker channels using the project’s passthrough tools.
resources.compatibility: PS5 native app PPSA99051. Publisher tested the passthrough sample on a jailbroken PS5 Pro, firmware 12.70, launched through ShadowMountPlus. HDMI bitstream tests require an audio chain that supports the selected codec. The project says its app runs inside its ordinary sandbox.
resources.preparation: The selected release ZIP contains the complete PPSA99051 native app folder. Copy that folder under /data/homebrew/PPSA99051 for ShadowMountPlus. Preserve its runtime and indexed audio clips. The sample README also describes a separate FFPFSC build; that is not the format of this selected ZIP.
requirements: Jailbroken PS5 with a compatible native app loader; publisher uses ShadowMountPlus
HDMI receiver/soundbar and intervening display that pass/accept the codec selected for passthrough tests
installationSteps: Extract the selected PPSA99051.zip and keep its complete PPSA99051 folder under /data/homebrew/.
Let ShadowMountPlus register the native title and launch it from the home screen.
Use the app's receiver-format display and choose a supported Passthrough clip or Speaker Lab test. Preserve the supplied clip index; /app0 folder enumeration is not available to the app.

firmwareSupport.notes: Publisher's PS5 Pro research/test setup. It is not a claim that every PS5 firmware, HDMI device or advertised audio format was tested.

primaryDocumentation.label: Pinned hardware test and codec results
Sample app controls and alternate build instructions

resources.title: Home5
resources.description: Control your configured Home Assistant rooms and devices from the console.
resources.compatibility: PS5 native media app PPSA11019 for a console that runs homebrew. Requires a reachable Home Assistant server and authorized account or access token. The pinned README supplies no firmware test matrix.
resources.preparation: Copy the complete PPSA11019 folder to /data/homebrew/PPSA11019 for your compatible loader, then open Home5 from Media. Enter the Home Assistant server's actual IP address and port; the author says homeassistant.local does not resolve on PS5. Sign in within the app and create your rooms manually.
requirements: Compatible native PS5 homebrew app environment
Reachable Home Assistant instance
Home Assistant credentials or an authorized long-lived access token
installationSteps: Extract PPSA11019.zip and copy the complete PPSA11019 folder under /data/homebrew/.
Open Home5 from Media and enter your own Home Assistant server IP/port, then complete sign-in in the app.
Create rooms with Options > New room. The app does not import or change the Home Assistant room structure automatically.
If using the documented USB token-file option, follow the source's cleanup instruction after importing it.

firmwareSupport.notes: No firmware-specific matrix in the pinned README.

primaryDocumentation.label: Pinned installation and Home Assistant setup

resources.title: ProsperoWeb
resources.description: Browse websites with controller navigation, tabs and bookmarks in a native PS5 app.
resources.compatibility: Experimental PS5 native browser PRWB00001. Requires a jailbroken PS5 with etaHEN or kstuff, ShadowMountPlus, and privileged elfldr at 127.0.0.1:9021; websrv on 8080 is a fallback. The author reports testing only firmware 13.42. The 160.6 MiB ZIP requires manual transfer/extraction outside the site's 32 MiB browser verification limit.
resources.preparation: Manually extract the complete PRWB00001 folder so its eboot.bin is at /data/homebrew/PRWB00001/eboot.bin. Keep prosperoweb.elf, prosperoweb-broker.elf, runtime modules, assets and licenses. Launch the native home-screen tile after ShadowMountPlus scans it; sending the browser ELF directly to Payload Manager/elfldr can create an invisible background browser instead.
requirements: Jailbroken PS5 with etaHEN or kstuff
ShadowMountPlus
Privileged ELF loader listening on 127.0.0.1:9021 for child processes; websrv 8080 fallback
Manual transfer/extraction for this large app bundle
installationSteps: Use a computer/file manager to extract the complete PRWB00001 folder; this selected archive exceeds the site's native extraction verification cap.
Place it at /data/homebrew/PRWB00001 with its complete runtime/assets/license tree and executable permissions preserved.
Start the required loader, wait for ShadowMountPlus's scan and launch the native ProsperoWeb tile. Its profile and log are under /data/prosperoweb/.
The separate websrv data bundle uses different folders and its own tile. Do not substitute a loose browser ELF for either documented launch route.

firmwareSupport.notes: Only the developer's 13.42 console is reported tested. The pinned README contains older 0.1.0 wording alongside the native route; selected asset is release v0.2.0, inspected contentVersion 01.002.000.

primaryDocumentation.label: Pinned native-title requirements and launch routes
